summary.text: Sarah Vance is a Republican member of the Alaska House of Representatives for District 6, serving since 2019.

paragraphs.text: In Vance's biography on the Alaska Legislature's member page, Vance writes that Vance and husband Jeff are raising four children in Homer, near where Vance grew up.
The biography says Vance graduated from the local university with degrees in small business and accounting and has run businesses.
